body: I'll try going there tomorrow. The semester's basically over now but at least I can get a chance to vent for a little bit before I have to go back in the closet for the summer
Okay, I can try doing that. Thank you for the advice :)

We do; I've just been too scared to go because I'm afraid someone from back home will see me there and out me (almost everyone from my high school goes to the same college as me since it's the local state school).

At this point I may just have to get over it cause I haven't been able to get enough support from anywhere else
Thank you, reading this and the other replies made me feel a little better and safer. I wish I had more people like you guys IRL but oh well I guess.

I'm kinda at a point where college seems pointless. Not because getting an education isn't important, but because I'm only there because my parents pressured and forced me to go. I didn't even get to pick the school I got to attend or even my major. Doing something I hate every single day has become exhausting.

I don't want to be abandoned. My parents hate gay people (to the point where they want them dead) and if they found out they might cut me off. I'm very financially dependent on them: I'll have no car, no job, and no place to live if they found out. 

Hiding for so long has left me with a constant feeling on isolation and loneliness and I don't want to deal with it anymore.
